analysis_summary: The document set describes a contractual relationship between ООО «ИнжКонтур Бета» (Contractor) and АО «Городские инженерные системы» (Customer) under contract КД-24/03-15. The contract was amended by Addendum №1 to increase the total value from 4.86M to 5.21M RUB. The set includes a Q1 2026 Financial Report (KFZ) which validates several work items (inspections, vibration measurements, sensor replacement, etc.) that appear in both the Q1 report and the April 2026 Act (А-024/26). An invoice from a third-party supplier (ООО «Вектор Прибор») is also present, referencing the same contract, likely for materials used in the project.
